value: NON-PROXIMITY DEFEATS SUPERVISION AND THE RATING RESTORES IT: clients in high-income countries cannot watch workers in SEA and SSA, so direct monitoring fails - and platform rating and ranking overcome exactly the spatial and temporal barriers that defeated it
quote: This weak structural power is an outcome of platform-based rating and ranking systems enabling a form of control which is able to overcome the spatial and temporal barriers that non-proximity places on the effectiveness of direct labour process surveillance and supervision.

value: RANKING IS THE SANCTION: platforms do not dismiss low-rated workers, they filter work away from them, so the penalty is invisible, gradual and unappealable - continuing on the platform simply stops being a viable living
quote: online labour platforms, instead, use algorithms to filter work away from those with low ratings, thus making continuing on the platform a less viable means of making a living.

value: DIRECT MONITORING WAS EASILY CIRCUMVENTED - keystroke counts and screenshots were worked around by timing and by a second monitor - which is why the reputational mechanism, not the surveillance mechanism, is the effective one
quote: For instance, frequencies of workers’ keyboard presses and mouse movements were tracked and shots taken of their screens. However, these monitoring mechanisms were easily circumvented.

value: WORKERS WELCOMED THE MONITORING because the platform guaranteed payment for monitored work: surveillance was traded for protection against wage theft, so the same mechanism is a safeguard and a control depending on who is short of power
quote: In fact, the monitoring was often welcomed by workers, because the platform guaranteed payments for monitored work, protecting workers from non-payment and wage theft
